operations.title: Entry 1216 — The Physical Five-Site Current Carries Only the External-Gram Kummer Density
operations.summary: With u_i=ell dot q_i on a labelled external basis H=Q^TQ, d^3 ell=du1 du2 du3/sqrt(det H). The physical coefficient character is therefore the external-Gram Kummer line. The unrestricted d=5 radial endpoint Kummer line has no ordinary pullback as a local system to the rank-constrained d=3 current; physical activation is inapplicable rather than zero.

operations.title: Benincasa derives the physical five-site external-Gram Kummer current
operations.body: Entry 1216 derives the physical current directly: for u=Q_ext^T ell and H=Q_ext^TQ_ext, d^3ell=du1∧du2∧du3/sqrt(det H). Thus physical five-site coefficient support is the existing external-Gram Kummer divisor det(H)=0. The unrestricted d=5 radial endpoint Kummer line does not pull back as a d=3 local system because the full CM determinant vanishes identically on rank<=3 support. Its physical activation is not applicable, not zero. Next I will pull the 180 labelled OFPT terms onto the three u coordinates and test linearity/compatibility.
